button.name: action_accept
button.invisible: status not in ('inventory', 'purchase', 'suppliers', 'tax_accounts', 'bank_acc') or not can_current_user_act

button.name: action_reject
button.invisible: status not in ('inventory', 'purchase', 'suppliers', 'tax_accounts', 'bank_acc') or not can_current_user_act

button.name: action_finish
button.invisible: status not in ('inventory', 'purchase', 'suppliers', 'tax_accounts', 'bank_acc') or not can_finish

button.name: action_supplier_notified
button.invisible: status != 'supplier_notification' or supplier_notified == True or not can_current_user_act

button.name: action_close_claim
button.invisible: (status not in ('supplier_notification', 'delivery')) or supplier_notified == False or not can_current_user_act

div.span: Please confirm that the supplier has been notified to visit the office and collect the cheque before closing the claim.

div.invisible: not has_tax_accounts or status not in ('tax_accounts', 'bank_acc', 'sign_check', 'supplier_notification', 'closed')

div.span: Upload the supplier's claim document (PDF, image, etc.)
The cycle cannot start without an attached document.

div.invisible: status not in ('supplier_notification', 'delivery', 'closed') or check_delivery_status not in ('check_delivered', 'mixed')

div.span: Upload a clear image of the signed cheque
Upload the supplier's personal ID image
Both images are required when marking the cheque as delivered.

div.invisible: status not in ('supplier_notification', 'delivery', 'closed') or check_delivery_status not in ('check_delivered', 'mixed')

div.div: Share a secure public tracking link with the supplier
